โปรดอ่านก่อนยื่นคำขอ ผู้ยื่นคำขอต้องยินย: Please read before applying. Applicants must agree to comply with all conditions.
ผู้ได้รับอนุญาตต้องนำงานที่ได้รับอนุญาตไ: The permit holder must use the permitted work without seeking commercial or business gain, whether directly or indirectly.
ผู้ได้รับอนุญาตต้องคงไว้ซึ่งความถูกต้องข: The permit holder must strictly preserve the accuracy of the content, format and punctuation of the original prepared by the Office of the Royal Society. Otherwise, the grantor may order the printing, use or dissemination to be suspended, and the permit holder shall have no right to claim any damages whatsoever from the Office of the Royal Society. During printing, use and dissemination, the grantor may require the permit holder to submit evidence or details, including copies of the permitted publications, electronic media, electronic data or other media, for verification.
สำนักงานราชบัณฑิตยสภาจะเขียนข้อความที่แส: The Office of the Royal Society will provide a statement of permission specifying all conditions set by the grantor, which the permit holder must print in the preface or display at the beginning of the permitted publication, electronic media, electronic data or other media.
ห้ามผู้ได้รับอนุญาตพิมพ์หรือทำให้ปรากฏข้: The permit holder must not print or display any other text or articles not copyrighted by the Office of the Royal Society in the publication, electronic media, electronic data or other media, unless permitted by the grantor.
หน้าปกสิ่งพิมพ์ สื่ออิเล็กทรอนิกส์ ข้อมู: The cover of any publication, electronic media, electronic data or other media to be distributed or used at an event must be printed or displayed as specified by the grantor, showing the title, author, event date and venue. Pictures or patterns in garish colours must not be printed unless permitted in writing by the grantor.
ผู้ได้รับอนุญาตที่กระทำการฝ่าฝืนเงื่อนไข: If the permit holder violates the conditions of the permission, the grantor may revoke the permission immediately, and the permit holder shall remain liable for any damage caused to the grantor.
ผู้อนุญาตอาจกำหนดเงื่อนไขอื่น ๆ เพิ่มเติ: The grantor may specify additional conditions in the permission.
